description: Tells a spec's publisher, and everyone who reads its page, how a build went. kind is worked (the build did what the spec says), problem (something in the spec was wrong, missing or unclear) or idea (a request or a suggestion). Give the version that was built, as spekkr.inputs.json has it, and the requirement's id, such as R3, when the feedback is about one; when that version's files name their requirements, it must be one of those. text is plain text of up to 2,000 characters; it is shown as written and never as markup. Feedback is public: it is shown on the spec's page under the signed-in person's username. Offer it to the person after a build, show them the words, and call this tool only when they say yes. One account may send 10 entries a day, 3 of them on one spec, and keeps at most 5 on one spec. This tool needs sign-in.

requirement.description: The id of the requirement the feedback is about, like R3. Leave it out when it is about the whole spec.

text.description: What happened, in plain text. Line breaks are kept.

version.description: The version of the spec that was built, like 1.4.0. It is the version in spekkr.inputs.json.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback on a spec
